ValidationRule.description: This rule will prohibit a user from changing a record owner when the lead record is already claimed (owner is not Adam) and the Lead Source is "Facebook - Landing Refi".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) , NOT($Permission.Lead_Owner_Reassignment), PRIORVALUE( OwnerId ) <> "005f2000009Buua" , ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Facebook - Landing Refi"), $User.UserRoleId <>"00E5x000002OGkS")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This record has already been claimed. You cannot change the record owner.
